# 2026-27 Classroom Slides

These classroom slides are designed to be used **in conjunction with the course notes and resources at [andrewandrade.ca/commons](https://andrewandrade.ca/commons)**.

Use the selectors below to jump to a course and instructional week.

<div class="slide-picker">
  <p>
    <label for="course-select"><strong>Course</strong></label><br>
    <select id="course-select">
      <option value="">Choose a course</option>
      <option value="tej">TEJ</option>
      <option value="tts">TTS</option>
      <option value="tas">TAS</option>
    </select>
  </p>

  <p>
    <label for="week-select"><strong>Week</strong></label><br>
    <select id="week-select">
      <option value="">Choose a week</option>
      <option value="week-01">Week 1</option>
    </select>
  </p>

  <button type="button" onclick="openSelectedWeek()">Open slides</button>
</div>

<script>
function openSelectedWeek() {
  const course = document.getElementById('course-select').value;
  const week = document.getElementById('week-select').value;

  if (!course || !week) {
    return;
  }

  window.location.href = `2026-27/semester-1/period-1/${course}/${week}/`;
}
</script>
